newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-WIMBLEDON WOMEN'S DOUBLES QUARTER-FINALS RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-WIMBLEDON WOMEN'S DOUBLES QUARTER-FINALS RESULTS.

text.p: Women's doubles quarter-finals results at Wimbledon on Friday (prefix number denotes seeding):
1-Gigi Fernandez (U.S.)/Natasha Zvereva (Belarus) beat 5-Mary Joe Fernandez (U.S.)/Lisa Raymond (U.S.) 5-7 6-4 6-4
12-Sabine Appelmans (Belgium)/Miriam Oremans (Netherlands) beat 3-Lindsay Davenport (U.S.)/Jana Novotna (Czech Republic) walkover
4-Larisa Neiland (Latvia)/Helena Sukova (Czech Republic) beat Els Callens (Belgium)/Ginger Helgeson Nielsen (U.S.) 6-4 6-4
6-Nicole Arendt (U.S.)/Manon Bollegraf (Netherlands) beat 2-Martina Hingis (Switzerland)/Arantxa Sanchez Vicario (Spain) 6-4 5-7 6-2
